pp2.3:1.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti, pāpadhammo asucisaṅkassarasamācāro, paṭicchannakammanto, asamaṇo, samaṇapaṭiñño, abrahmacārī, brahmacārīpatiñño, antopūtī, avassuto, kasambukajāto:
pp2.3:1.4: itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññavimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī ti:
pp2.3:1.6: kudāssu nāmāham pi āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . upasampajja viharissāmī ti:
pp2.3:2.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo:
pp2.3:2.4: itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññavimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī ti:
pp2.3:2.6: kudāssu nāmāham pi āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . upasampajja viharissāmī ti:
pp2.3:3.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññavimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī ti:
pp2.3:3.4: itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . upasampajja viharatī ti;
pp2.3:3.6: kudāssu nāmāham pi āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . viharissāmī ti.
pp2.3:3.8: Yā hi 'ssa pubbe avimuttassa vimuttāsā sā hi paṭipassaddhā
pp2.3:4.3: Idh' ekacco gilāno labhanto vā sappāyāni bhojanāni alabhanto vā sappāyāni bhojanāni, labhanto vā sappāyāni bhesajjāni alabhanto vā sappāyāni bhesajjāni, labhanto vā paṭirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ alabhanto vā paṭirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ n' eva vuṭṭhāti tamhā ābādhā.
pp2.3:5.1: Idha pan' ekacco gilāno labhanto vā sappāyāni bhojanāni alabhanto vā sappāyāni bhojanāni, labhanto vā sappāyāni bhesajjāni alabhanto vā sappāyāni bhesajjāni, labhanto vā paṭirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ alabhanto vā paṭirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ vuṭṭhāti tamhā ābādhā.
pp2.3:6.1: Idha pan' ekacco gilāno labhanto sappāyāni bhojanāni no alabhanto, labhanto sappāyāni bhesajjāni no alabhanto, labhanto paṭirūpam upaṭṭhākaṃ no alabhanto vuṭṭhāti tamhā abādhā.
pp2.3:7.1: Tatra yvāyaṃ gilāno labhanto sappāyāni bhojanāni no alabhanto, labhato sappāyāni bhesajjāni no alabhanto, labhanto paṭirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ no alabhanto vuṭṭhāti tamhā ābādhā, imaṃ gilānaṃ paṭicca Bhagavatā gilānabhattaṃ anuññātaṃ, gilānabhesajjaṃ anuññātaṃ, gilānupaṭṭhāko anuññāto;
pp2.3:7.2: imañ ca pana gilānaṃ paṭicca aññe pi gilānā upaṭṭhātabbā.
pp2.3:8.1: Evam evaṃ tayo gilānupamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
pp2.3:8.3: Idh' ekacco puggalo labhanto vā Tathāgataṃ dassanāya alabhanto vā Tathāgataṃ dassanāya, labhanto vā Tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savanāya, alabhanto vā Tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savanāya, n' eva okkamati niyāmaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
pp2.3:9.1: Idha pan' ekacco puggalo labhanto vā . . . pe . . . savanāya okkamati niyāmaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
pp2.3:10.1: Idha pan' ekacco puggalo labhanto Tathāgataṃ dassanāya no alabhanto, labhanto Tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savanāya no alabhanto okkamati niyāmaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
pp2.3:11.1: Tatra yo ayaṃ puggalo labhanto Tathāgataṃ dassanāya no alabhanto, labhanto Tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savanāya no alabhanto okkamati niyāmaṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ, imaṃ puggalaṃ paṭicca Bhagavatā dhammadesanā anuññātā: imañ ca pana puggalaṃ paṭicca aññesam pi dhammo desetabbo:
pp2.3:11.2: ime tayo gilānupamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. 3.
pp2.3:12.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya c' assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhiṇā honti,
pp2.3:13.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, Tathāgatappaveditā c' assa dhammā paññāya vo diṭṭhā honti vo caritā, paññāya c' assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti,
pp2.3:14.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . .
pp2.3:14.3: [I.34] āsavā parikkhīṇā honti no ca kho yathā diṭṭhipattassa,
pp2.3:15.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo musāvādī hoti sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgāmajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhi-puṭṭho:-- ehi
pp2.3:15.3: bho purisa yaṃ jānāsi taṃ vadehī ti.
pp2.3:15.4: So ajānaṃ vā aham jānāmī ti,
pp2.3:15.5: jānaṃ vā ahaṃ na jānāmī ti,
pp2.3:15.7: passaṃ vā ahaṃ na passāmī ti,
pp2.3:15.8: iti attahetu vā parahetu vā āmisakiñcikkhahetu vā sampajānamusā bhāsitā hoti:
pp2.3:16.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho:--
pp2.3:16.3: ehi bho purisa yaṃ jānāsi taṃ vadehī ti.
pp2.3:16.4: So ajānaṃ vā ahaṃ na jānāmī ti,
pp2.3:16.6: apassaṃ vā ahaṃ na passāmī ti,
pp2.3:16.8: iti attahetu vā parahetu vā āmisakiñcikkhahetu vā na sampajānamusābhāsitā hoti:
pp2.3:17.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo yā sā vācā neḷā, kaṇṇasukhā, pemaniyā, hadayaṅgamā, porī, bahujanakantā, bahujanamanāpā, tathārūpaṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti,
pp2.3:18.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti, upāyāsabahulo, appaṃ pi vutto samāno, abhisajjati, kuppati, vyāpajjati, patiṭṭhīyati, kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti:
pp2.3:18.3: seyyathāpi nāma duṭṭhāruko kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhīyyosomattāya āsavaṃ deti:
pp2.3:18.4: evam evaṃ idh' ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti . . . pe . . . pātukaroti:
pp2.3:19.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe [III.3] . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti:
pp2.3:19.3: seyyathāpi nāma cakkhumā puriso rattandhakāratimisāya vijjantarikāya rūpāni passeyya:
pp2.3:19.4: evam eva idh' ekacco puggalo . . . pe . . . pajānāti:
pp2.3:20.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati:
pp2.3:20.3: seyyathāpi nāma vajirassa n' atthi kiñci abhejjaṃ maṇi vā pāsāṇo vā:
pp2.3:20.4: evam evaṃ idh' ekacco puggalo āsavānaṃ . . . pe . . . viharati:
pp2.3:21.2: Idh' ekaccassa puggalassa tathārūpaṃ cakkhu na hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigaccheyya adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātiṃ kāreyya
pp2.3:21.3: tathārūpaṃ pi 'ssa cakkhu na hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā kusalā kusale dhamme jāneyya, sāvajjānavajje dhamme jāneyya, hīnapaṇīte dhamme jāneyya, kaṇha-sukka-sappaṭibhāge dhamme jāneyya:
pp2.3:22.2: Idh' ekaccassa puggalassa tathārūpaṃ cakkhu hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigaccheyya adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātiṃ kareyya
pp2.3:22.3: tathārūpam pi 'ssa cakkhu na hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā kusalā kusale dhamme jāneyya, sāvajjānavajje dhamme jāneyya, hīnapaṇīte dhamme jāneyya, kaṇha-sukka-sappaṭibhāge dhamme jāneyya:
pp2.3:23.2: Idh' ekaccassa puggalassa tathārūpaṃ cakkhu hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigaccheyya adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātiṃ kareyya,
pp2.3:23.3: tathārūpam pi 'ssa cakkhu hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā kusalā kusale dhamme jāneyya, sāvajjānavajje dhamme jāneyya, hīnapaṇīte dhamme jāneyya, kaṇha-sukka-sappaṭibhāge dhamme jāneyya:
pp2.3:24.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo ārāmaṃ gantvā hoti abhikkhaṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ santike dhammasavanāya:
pp2.3:24.3: tassa bhikkhū dhammaṃ desenti ādi kalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāṇaṃ kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevala-paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsenti:
pp2.3:24.4: so tasmiṃ āsane nisinno tassā kathāya n' eva ādiṃ manasikaroti, na majjhaṃ manasikaroti, na pariyosānaṃ manasikaroti;
pp2.3:24.5: vuṭṭhito pi tamhā āsanā tassā kathāya n' eva ādiṃ . . . pe . . . pariyosānaṃ manasikaroti:
pp2.3:24.6: seyyathāpi nāma kumbho nikkujjo tatra udakaṃ āsittaṃ vivattati no saṇṭhāti,
pp2.3:24.7: evam evaṃ idh' ekacco puggalo ārāmam . . . pe . . .
pp2.3:25.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo ārāmaṃ gantvā hoti abhikkaṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ santike dhammasavanāya:
pp2.3:25.3: tassa bhikkhū dhammaṃ desenti ādi kalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosānaṃ kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsenti:
pp2.3:25.4: so tasmim āsane nisinno tassā kathāya ādim pi manasikaroti majjham pi manasikaroti pariyosānam pi manasikaroti:
pp2.3:25.5: vuṭṭhito ca kho tamhā āsanā tassā kathāya n' eva ādiṃ manasikaroti na majjhaṃ manasikaroti na pariyosānaṃ manasikaroti:
pp2.3:25.6: seyyathāpi nāma purisassa ucchaṅge nānākhajjakāni ākiṇṇāni
pp2.3:25.8: so tamhā āsanā vuṭṭhahanto satisammosā pakireyya;
pp2.3:25.9: evam evaṃ idh' ekacco puggalo ārāmaṃ . . . pe . . .
pp2.3:26.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo āramaṃ gantvā hoti . . .
pp2.3:26.5: vuṭṭhito pi tamhā āsanā tassā kathāya ādim pi manasikaroti majjham pi manasikaroti pariyosānaṃ pi manasikaroti;
pp2.3:26.6: seyyathāpi kumbho ukkujjo tatth' eva udakaṃ āsittaṃ saṇṭhāti no vivattati:
pp2.3:26.7: evam evaṃ idh' ekacco puggalo ārāmaṃ . . .
pp2.3:27.1: Katamo ca puggalo kāmesu ca bhavesu ca avītarāgo?
pp2.3:27.3: ime vuccanti puggalā kāmesu ca bhavesu ca avītarāgā.
pp2.3:28.1: Katamo ca puggalo kāmesu vītarāgo bhavesu avītarāgo?
pp2.3:28.3: ayaṃ vuccati puggalo kāmesu vītarāgo bhāvesu avītarāgo.
pp2.3:29.1: Katamo ca puggalo kāmesu ca bhavesu ca vitarāgo?
pp2.3:29.3: ayaṃ vuccati puggalo kāmesu ca bhavesu ca vītarāgo. 9.
pp2.3:30.3: so ca khvassa kodho ciraṃ dīgharattaṃ anuseti;
pp2.3:30.4: seyyathāpi nāma pāsāṇalekhā na khippaṃ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā ciraṭṭhitikā hoti,
pp2.3:31.3: so ca khvassa kodho na ciraṃ dīgharattaṃ anuseti;
pp2.3:31.4: seyyathāpi nāma paṭhaviyā lekhā khippaṃ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti,
pp2.3:32.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo agāḷhena pi vuccamāno pharusena pi vuccamāno amanāpena pi vuccamāno saṃsandati c' eva sandhīyati c' eva sammodati c' eva;
pp2.3:32.3: seyyathāpi nāma udakalekhā khippaṃ lujjati na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti,
pp2.3:32.4: evam evaṃ idh' ekacco puggalo . . . sammodati c' eva:
pp2.3:33.3: navo pi potthako dubbaṇṇo c' eva hoti dukkhasamphasso ca appaggho ca, majjhimo pi potthako dubbaṇṇo c' eva hoti dukkhasamphasso ca appaggho ca, jiṇṇo pi potthako dubbaṇṇo c' eva hoti dukkhasamphasso ca appaggho ca;
pp2.3:33.4: jiṇṇam pi potthakaṃ ukkhaliparimajjamaṃ vā karonti saṅkārakūṭe vā naṃ chaḍḍenti.
pp2.3:33.5: Evam evaṃ tayo 'me potthakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamāna bhikkhūsu.
pp2.3:33.7: Navo ce pi bhikkhu hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo, idam assa dubbaṇṇatāya:
pp2.3:33.8: seyyathāpi so potthako dubbaṇṇo, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:33.9: Ye kho pan' assa sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti tesaṃ taṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya,
pp2.3:33.11: seyyathāpi so potthako dukkhasamphasso tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:33.12: Yesaṃ kho pana paṭigaṇhāti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ tesaṃ taṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti na mahānisaṃ saṃ,
pp2.3:33.14: seyyathāpi so potthako appaggho, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo:
pp2.3:34.1: majjhimo ce pi bhikkhu hoti . . . pe . . .
pp2.3:34.2: thero ce pi bhikkhu hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo, idam assa dubbaṇṇatāya:
pp2.3:34.3: seyyathāpi so potthako dubbaṇṇo, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:34.4: Ye kho pan' assa sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti tesan taṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya,
pp2.3:34.6: seyyathāpi so potthako dukkhasamphasso tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:34.7: Yesaṃ kho pana paṭigaṇhāti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ tesan taṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti na mahānisaṃsaṃ,
pp2.3:34.9: seyyathāpi so potthako appaggho, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:35.1: Evarūpo ce thero bhikkhu saṅghamajjhe bhaṇati
pp2.3:35.3: kiṃ nu kho tuyhaṃ bālassa avyattassa bhaṇitena tvaṃ pi nāma bhaṇitabbaṃ maññasīti:
pp2.3:35.4: so kuppito anattamano tathārūpaṃ vācaṃ nicchāreti: yathārūpāya vācāya saṅgho tam ukkhipati saṅkārakūṭe va naṃ potthakaṃ
pp2.3:35.5: ime tayo potthakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu. 11.
pp2.3:36.3: navam pi kāsikavatthaṃ vaṇṇavantaṃ c' eva hoti sukhasamphassañ ca mahagghañ ca; majjimam pi kāsikavatthaṃ vaṇṇavantaṃ c' eva hoti sukhasamphassañ ca mahagghañ ca; jiṇṇam pi kāsikavatthaṃ vaṇṇavantaṃ c' eva hoti sukhasamphassañ cā mahagghañ ca;
pp2.3:36.4: jiṇṇam pi kāsikavatthaṃ ratanapaliveṭhanaṃ vā karonti gandhakaraṇḍake vā naṃ nikkhipanti.
pp2.3:37.1: Evam evaṃ tayo' me kāsikavatthūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu.
pp2.3:37.3: Navo ce pi bhikkhu hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, idam assa suvaṇṇatāya:
pp2.3:37.4: seyyathāpi taṃ kāsikavatthaṃ vaṇṇavantaṃ, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:37.5: Ye kho pan' assa sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti tesaṃ taṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
pp2.3:37.7: seyyathāpi taṃ kāsikavatthaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:37.8: Yesaṃ kho pana paṭigaṇhāti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ tesaṃ taṃ mahāphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsaṃ,
pp2.3:37.10: seyyathāpi taṃ kāsikavatthaṃ mahagghaṃ tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo:
pp2.3:38.2: thero ce pi bhikkhu hoti sīlavā kalyānadhammo, idam assa suvaṇṇatāya,
pp2.3:38.3: seyyathāpi kāsikavatthaṃ vaṇṇavantaṃ tath' ūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:38.4: Ye kho pan' assa sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti tesaṃ tam hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya,
pp2.3:38.6: seyyathāpi taṃ kāsikavatthaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ, tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:38.7: Yesaṃ kho pana paṭigaṇhāti civarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ tesaṃ taṃ mahaphalaṃ hoti mahanisaṃsaṃ,
pp2.3:38.9: seyyathāpi taṃ kāsikavatthaṃ mahagghaṃ tathūpamo ayaṃ puggalo.
pp2.3:39.1: Evarūpo ce thero bhikkhu saṅghamajjhe bhaṇati, tam enaṃ bhikkhū evam āhaṃsu:--
pp2.3:39.2: appasaddā āyasmanto hotha, thero bhikkhu dhammañ ca vinayañ ca bhaṇatī ti,
pp2.3:39.3: tassa taṃ vacanaṃ ādheyyaṃ gacchati gandhakaraṇḍake va naṃ kāsikavatthaṃ
pp2.3:39.4: ime tayo kāsikavatthūpamā puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu. 12.
pp2.3:40.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo uddhato hoti, unnalo, capalo, mukharo, vikiṇṇavāco, muṭṭhasati, asampajāno, asamāhito, vibbhantacitto, pākatindriyo:
pp2.3:41.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo anuddhato hoti, anunnalo, acapalo amukharo, avikiṇṇavāco, uppaṭṭhitasati, sampajāno, samāhito, ekaggacitto, saṃvutindriyo:
pp2.3:42.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati:
pp2.3:43.1: Katamo ca puggalo na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo?
pp2.3:43.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo hīno hoti sīlena samādhinā paññāya,
pp2.3:43.3: evarūpo puggalo na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo aññatra anuddayā, aññatra anukampā.
pp2.3:44.1: Katamo ca puggalo sevitabbo, bhajitabbo, payirupāsitabbo?
pp2.3:44.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo sadiso hoti sīlena samādhinā paññāya,
pp2.3:44.5: Sīlasāmaññagatānaṃ sataṃ sīlakathā ca no bhavissati, sā ca no phāsu bhavissati, sā ca no pavattinī bhavissati;
pp2.3:44.6: samādhisāmaññagatānaṃ sataṃ samādhikathā ca no bhavissati, sā ca no phāsu bhavissati, sā ca no pavattinī bhavissati;
pp2.3:44.7: paññāsāmaññagatānaṃ sataṃ paññākathā ca no bhavissati, sā ca no phāsu bhavissati, sā ca no pavattinī bhavissati;
pp2.3:44.8: tasmā evarūpo puggalo sevitabbo, bhajitabbo, payirupāsitabbo.
pp2.3:45.1: Katamo ca puggalo sakkatvā garuṅkatvā sevitabbo, bhajitabbo, payirupāsitabbo?
pp2.3:45.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo adhiko hoti sīlena samādhinā paññāya
pp2.3:45.3: evarūpo puggalo sakkatvā garuṅkatvā sevitabbo, bhajitabbo, payirupāsitabbo.
pp2.3:45.5: Aparipūraṃ vā sīlakkhandhaṃ paripūrissāmi paripūraṃ vā sīlakkhandhaṃ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahissāmi;
pp2.3:45.6: aparipūraṃ vā samādhikkhandhaṃ paripūrissāmi paripūraṃ vā samādhikkhandhaṃ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahissāmi;
pp2.3:45.7: aparipūraṃ vā paññākkhandhaṃ paripūrissāmi paripūraṃ vā paññākkhandhaṃ tattha tattha paññāya anuggahissāmi:
pp2.3:45.8: tasmā evarūpo puggalo sakkatvā garuṅkatvā sevitabbo, bhajitabbo, payirūpāsitabbo. 14.
pp2.3:46.1: Katamo ca puggalo jigucchitabbo, na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo?
pp2.3:46.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti, pāpadhammo, asucisaṅkassarasamācāro, paṭicchannakammanto, asamaṇo, samaṇapaṭiñño, abrahmacārī, brahmacāripaṭiñño, antopūtī, avassuto, kasambukajāto,
pp2.3:46.3: evarūpo puggalo jigucchitabbo, na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo.
pp2.3:46.5: Kiñcāpi evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭhānugatim āpajjati, atha kho naṃ pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati
pp2.3:46.7: seyyathāpi nāma ahigūthagato kiñcāpi na ḍassati atha kho naṃ makkheti:
pp2.3:46.8: evam evaṃ kiñcāpi evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ pāpo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati
pp2.3:46.10: tasmā evarūpo puggalo jigucchitabbo, na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo.
pp2.3:47.1: Katamo ca puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo?
pp2.3:47.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo appaṃ pi vutto samāno abhisajjati, kuppati, vyāpajjati, patiṭṭhīyati, kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti,
pp2.3:47.3: seyyathāpi nāma duṭṭhāruko kāṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhīyyo-somattāya āsavaṃ deti, evam evam idh' ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo . . . pe . . .
pp2.3:47.4: seyyathāpi nāma tiṇḍukālātaṃ kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭitaṃ bhīyyo-somattāya cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati,
pp2.3:47.5: evam evam idh' ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo . . . pe . . .
pp2.3:47.6: seyyathāpi nāma gūthakūpo kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhīyyo-somattāya duggandho hoti,
pp2.3:47.7: evam evaṃ idh' ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo appam pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati vyāpajjati patiṭṭhīyati kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaroti:
pp2.3:47.10: Akkoseyyā pi maṃ paribhāseyyā pi maṃ anattham pi me kareyyā ti:
pp2.3:47.11: tasmā evarūpo puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo, na sevitabbo, na bhajitabbo, na payirupāsitabbo.
pp2.3:48.1: Katamo ca puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo?
pp2.3:48.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo,
pp2.3:48.5: Kiñcāpi evarūpassa puggalassa pana diṭṭhānugatim āpajjati, atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhugacchati
pp2.3:48.7: tasmā evarūpo puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo. 15.
pp2.3:49.1: Katamo ca puggalo sīlesu paripūrakārī samādhismim mattasokārī paññāya mattasokārī?
pp2.3:49.3: ime vuccanti puggalā sīlesu paripūrakārino samādhismiṃ mattasokārino paññāya mattasokārino.
pp2.3:50.1: Katamo ca puggalo sīlesu ca paripūrakārī samādhismiñ ca paripūrakārī paññāya mattasokārī?
pp2.3:50.3: ayaṃ vuccati puggalo sīlesu ca paripūrakārī samādhismiñ ca paripūrakārī paññāya mattasokārī.
pp2.3:51.1: Katamo ca puggalo sīlesu ca paripūrakārī samādhismiñ ca paripūrakārī paññāya ca paripūrakārī?
pp2.3:51.3: ayaṃ vuccati puggalo sīlesu ca paripūrakārī samādhismiñ ca paripūrakārī paññāya ca paripūrakārī. 16.
pp2.3:52.2: Idh' ekacco satthā kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti, na rūpānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti, na vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti.
pp2.3:52.3: Idha pan' ekacco satthā kāmānañ ca pariññaṃ paññāpeti rūpānañ ca pariññaṃ paññāpeti na vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti.
pp2.3:52.4: Idha pan' ekacco satthā kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti rūpānañ ca pariññaṃ paññāpeti vedanānañ ca pariññaṃ paññāpeti.
pp2.3:53.1: Tatra yvāyaṃ satthā kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti na rūpānañ pariññaṃ paññāpeti na vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti rūpāvacarasamāpattiyā lābhī satthā tena daṭṭhabbo.
pp2.3:53.2: Tatra yvāyaṃ satthā kāmānañ ca pariññaṃ paññāpeti rūpānañ ca pariññaṃ paññāpeti na vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti arūpāvacarasamāpattiyā lābhī satthā tena daṭṭhabbo.
pp2.3:53.3: Tatra yvāyaṃ satthā kāmānañ ca pariññaṃ paññāpeti rūpānañ ca pariññaṃ paññāpeti vedanānañ ca pariññaṃ paññāpeti sammāsambuddho satthā tena daṭṭhabbo.
pp2.3:54.1: Tattha katame apare pi tayo satthāro?
pp2.3:54.2: Idh' ekacco satthā diṭṭh' eva dhamme attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti, abhisaṃparāyañ ca attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti.
pp2.3:54.3: Idha pen' ekacco satthā diṭṭh' eva dhamme attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti, no ca kho abhisamparāyam attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti.
pp2.3:54.4: Idha pañ' ekacco satthā diṭṭh' eva dhamme attānaṃ saccato thetato na paññāpeti, abhisamparāyañ ca attānaṃ saccato thetato na paññāpeti.
pp2.3:55.1: Tatra yvāyaṃ satthā diṭṭh' eva dhamme attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti, abhisamparāyañ ca attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti sassatavādo satthā tena daṭṭhabbo.
pp2.3:55.2: Tatra yvāyaṃ satthā diṭṭh' eva dhamme attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti, no ca kho abhisamparāyaṃ attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti ucchedavādo satthā tena daṭṭhabbo.
pp2.3:55.3: Tatra yvāyaṃ satthā deṭṭh' eva dhamme attānaṃ saccato thetato na paññāpeti, abhisamparāyañ ca attānaṃ saccato thetato na paññāpeti sammāsambuddho satthā tena daṭṭhabbo.
